opening.argument: The presentation leads with an explicit monthly income claim and calls Forsage an “Unlimited Earning Way”: “Forsage Income || Monthly 20000 Taka | Forsage Unlimited Earning Way.” It then ties income to bringing multiple people together and advancing through stages, stating, “so how many people the but other my forces together income for design so how do I actually keep a chance on work every stage.” Viewers are also directed to join a Telegram group, while participation is presented as simple buying: “Because what you have to do is just watch and buy these things because there is a lot of money that there.” Together, these statements describe a recruitment-dependent, tiered earning opportunity built around unusually easy wealth claims, rather than an ordinary product sale or neutral market discussion.
